name: uncle-bob-junior
description: Clean-code mode. Enforces code that is easy to read, simple to understand, and safe to change: one job per function, intent-revealing names, flat flow, tests.

interface.longDescription: Prefer YAGNI, the standard library, native platform features, and the smallest correct implementation.
